gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-roboto-condensed: Commanding in spirit, Wallpoet lays down tall lowercase with paper showing through its lines. Roboto Condensed follows in tight, compact sans, gliding under the eye like a wire pulled taut over a long page.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-saira-semi-condensed:
Wallpoet's strokes are low in contrast and stencil-cut, with space glowing between letters.
Saira Semi Condensed keeps round letters as heavy as its straight ones, so a long stretch of sans text reads magnified and steady from word to word.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-smooch-sans:
Smooch Sans reads tight and modern, its gaps almost gone.
Wallpoet's smooth bends and high lowercase make the pair's strongest quality plain: a loud, confident top over a body that packs in close and stays out of the way.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Wallpoet takes the heading with smooth curves and lowercase that climbs high, no hairlines or swells anywhere. And Sofia Sans Condensed carries on in approachable sans-serif, its big x-height making a longer passage feel open and unshaded.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-spline-sans-mono:
Precise and technical, Spline Sans Mono sets fixed-width letters in one flat line.
Wallpoet does the loud, smooth-curved announcing, while the monospace does the ruler-straight, steady work of carrying text with lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-tiny5:
Tiny5 reads tall and clean, with ascenders that look short because the body is so big.
Wallpoet is best at bold, smooth-bending display; Tiny5 is best at staying approachable and plain in sans text below it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-truculenta:
Wallpoet draws smooth curves with high lowercase, and no hairlines or swells appear anywhere in them.
Truculenta packs its sans text into a compact, approachable line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-ubuntu:
Ubuntu reads modern, with a lofty lowercase band that stands up straight on the line.
Ubuntu sits under Wallpoet's bold, commanding heading as plain sans, letting the display do the shouting while the text keeps its head level.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-victor-mono:
Victor Mono lays out precise monospace letters with loose spacing, bowls left open on one side, and zero stroke contrast.
Its strongest quality is structure against Wallpoet's swagger.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-viga:
Wallpoet's most distinctive trait is a smooth, low-contrast curve that lets paper show through between its bold letters.
Viga's flat sans could go a touch larger.
